geometry_findings.finding: Pointed flattened forebody; single-seat canopy with windscreen frame; no long nose boom in these game views. No visible contradiction to base drawing.
geometry_findings.limit: Game nose appears wider in low-angle closeup because of perspective; do not infer a new subtype from that apparent width.

geometry_findings.finding: Broad blended centerbody and swept trapezoid wings; root leading-edge surfaces immediately above intakes; horizontal tail separate behind main wing. Shared layout is visible.
geometry_findings.limit: 120px icon is an identification symbol; cannot certify fine sweep angle or edge offsets. No pixel-size claim of game-to-drawing identity.

geometry_findings.finding: Two separated, dark, angular inlet openings below the forward wing-root area. Game and drawing agree on this external topology.
geometry_findings.limit: Front aperture angles/width and internal ramps are not measured from an orthographic game view; use drawing cross-section for base and official perspective for appearance, not fabricated ducts.

geometry_findings.finding: Outward-canted twin fins; separated round nozzles; central tapered tail fairing between them; separate swept horizontal tail. No flat rectangular exhaust in the observed AC8 model.
geometry_findings.limit: No exact fin cant angle inferred; small tail-root fairing/inlet details and nozzle-deflection state need game closeups for close shots.

geometry_findings.finding: Some nose sensor bulges, lights/gear and upper fuselage panels are visible. Toprak 022/gold stripe is game-specific.
geometry_findings.limit: Full belly bay-door boundaries, opposite-side marking layout and rear small apertures remain unobserved. Do not substitute real-aircraft latest-production details.
